source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Uses gifts while noting the Greek's broader spiritual-things sense.
key_decisions.before: Now concerning spiritual matters, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.
key_decisions.after: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now concerning spiritual matters, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps former identity and passive misdirection.
key_decisions.before: You know that when you were Gentiles, you were led astray to mute idols, however you were led.
key_decisions.after: You know that when you were Gentiles, you were led astray to mute idols, however you were led.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: You know that when you were Gentiles, you were led astray to mute idols, however you were led.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves two confessions and Spirit criterion.
key_decisions.before: So I reveal to you that no one speaking in the Spirit of God says, “Jesus is accursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except in the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, I want you to know that no one speaking by God's Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking in the Spirit of God says, “Jesus is accursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except in the Holy Spirit.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves individual gift and communal purpose.
key_decisions.before: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.
key_decisions.after: A manifestation of the Spirit is given to each person for the common good.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.

key_decisions.before: to another workings of powers, to another prophecy, to another discernments of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, to another interpretation of tongues.
key_decisions.after: to another workings of miracles, to another prophecy, to another discernment of spirits, to another various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to another workings of powers, to another prophecy, to another discernments of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, to another interpretation of tongues.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains ethnic and status pairs, including slavery.
key_decisions.before: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and all were made to drink of one Spirit.
key_decisions.after: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, enslaved or free—and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and all were made to drink of one Spirit.

key_decisions.before: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem to be weaker are necessary,
key_decisions.after: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem weaker are indispensable,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem to be weaker are necessary,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves embodied social analogy and dignity.
key_decisions.before: and those parts of the body that we think less honorable we bestow greater honor, and our unpresentable parts are treated with greater modesty,
key_decisions.after: and those members we consider less honorable we clothe with greater honor, while our unpresentable parts are treated with greater modesty.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and those parts of the body that we think less honorable we bestow greater honor, and our unpresentable parts are treated with greater modesty,

key_decisions.before: while our presentable parts have no need. But God has so composed the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,
key_decisions.after: Our presentable parts have no need of this. But God has composed the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: while our presentable parts have no need. But God has so composed the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps order and complete ministry list.
key_decisions.before: God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then works of power, then gifts of healings, helps, administrations, various kinds of tongues.
key_decisions.after: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, helping, leading, and various kinds of tongues.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then works of power, then gifts of healings, helps, administrations, various kinds of tongues.

key_decisions.before: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And yet I show you a still more excellent way.
key_decisions.after: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you a way beyond all comparison.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And yet I show you a still more excellent way.
